hero.eyebrow: Active land search · Los Lagos & Patagonia
hero.title: Find your place in Patagonia.
hero.lead: Patagonia Land Hunter is LAND ADVISORS' active search service: we define where and what to look for, evaluate opportunities with local expertise, and guide you through the purchase—with clarity and confidence.
what.label: Patagonia Land Hunter
what.title: Active land search. Independent guidance.
what.lead: We specialize in buyer-side land advisory. We are not a brokerage or listing portal—we have no inventory of our own to sell.
what.body: Many buyers—in Chile and abroad—know what they want but not which area to focus on, which questions to ask, or how to compare options with real criteria. This service structures that path.
includes.label: What may be included
includes.title: A structured search with clear deliverables
includes.lead: Every engagement is tailored to your objective. Typical components of Patagonia Land Hunter:
includes.item1: Search brief: objective, budget, size, access, connectivity, land use and timeline
includes.item2: Target areas in Los Lagos and/or Patagonia—plus criteria to rule out mismatched zones
includes.item3: Active search across public listings, local networks and off-market contacts
includes.item4: Curated shortlist: a focused set of strong options, not a mass listing catalog
includes.item5: Preliminary field review: access, surroundings, connectivity, early signals and key questions before you make an offer
includes.item6: Site-visit coordination and joint tours when appropriate
includes.item7: Support comparing options and preparing to negotiate
includes.item8: Coordination with lawyers, brokers and technical professionals—without replacing their reports
includes.disclaimer: LAND ADVISORS does not replace legal advice, title review, survey, environmental or engineering studies. When needed, we help you engage those services before closing.
includes.risk.title: Navigating legal and practical complexity
includes.risk.body: Buying land in Chile involves zoning, subdivision rules, services, access and documentation that vary by municipality. We help you move forward in order: what to review, when, and with whom—before you commit capital.
why.label: Where we work
why.title: Two regions. Distinct opportunities.
why.lead: We deliver this service across Los Lagos and Chilean Patagonia—with local presence, fieldwork and contact networks.
why.note: There is no single best area. There is an area that fits your objective, budget and how you plan to use the land.
zone.lagos.title: Los Lagos Region
zone.lagos.text: Lago Llanquihue basin, Puerto Varas, Frutillar, Llanquihue and rural land near town: nature, services, flights from Santiago and quality of life. A strong fit when you want landscape and access in balance.
zone.lagos.bullet2: Services, connectivity and town life nearby
zone.lagos.bullet3: Second home, family project or long-term investment
zone.patagonia.title: Patagonia
zone.patagonia.text: From northern Patagonia to more remote ground: large landscapes, privacy, lifestyle projects, conservation or tourism with a long horizon.
process.label: How we guide you
process.title: Six steps we navigate with international buyers
process.lead: Buying land in Chile from overseas involves steps most buyers prefer to delegate—always with local expertise and clear communication.
step1.title: Suitable properties
step1.text: We identify options that fit your brief through partner brokers and trusted local contacts—a focused, curated search.
step2.title: Area guidance
step2.text: We help you understand which areas make sense for your objective, budget and how you plan to use the land.
step3.title: Legal verification
step3.text: We coordinate what to review and with whom—titles, easements and documentation—before you commit capital.
step4.title: Zoning and subdivisions
step4.text: Early read of local rules: what you can build, how the lot is divided and early warning signs.
step5.title: Negotiation support
step5.text: We compare options, position your offer and support negotiation with market and local context.
step6.title: Lawyers and notaries
step6.text: Coordination with Chilean professionals through closing. We do not replace their advice—we help you move forward with clarity.
intl.label: International buyers
intl.title: Your local partner in Patagonia
intl.lead: Buying land in Chile from abroad requires local presence, regional expertise and someone who can visit and evaluate opportunities before you travel.
intl.eyes: LAND ADVISORS can be your eyes on the ground in Southern Chile.
intl.partners.title: Working with international partners
intl.partners.text: We partner with real estate advisors who already have a client interested in Chile—we act as the local land partner while you keep the client relationship.
